definitions.gloss: detailed examination; thorough checkup; comprehensive testing
definitions.explanation: A thorough medical examination or inspection that goes beyond routine screening, typically ordered when an abnormality is suspected.

examples.japanese: {精密検査|せいみつけんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
⟦{健康診断|けんこうしんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{異常|いじょう}→異常：01716_ijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかり→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧、{精密検査|せいみつけんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勧|すす}められた→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: An abnormality was found during my health checkup, and I was advised to get a detailed examination.

examples.japanese: {精密検査|せいみつけんさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{特|とく}に→特に：01260_tokuni⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{安心|あんしん}した→安心する：06067_anshinsuru⟧。
examples.english: I was relieved when the detailed examination results showed no particular problems.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{精密|せいみつ}→精密：13775_seimitsu⟧ (precise, detailed) + ⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧ (examination, inspection). Refers to a more thorough level of testing than a routine screening or checkup.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {精密検査|せいみつけんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to undergo a detailed examination)
- {精密検査|せいみつけんさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧ (results of the detailed examination)
- {精密検査|せいみつけんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勧|すす}められる→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧ (to be advised to get a detailed exam)
- {精密検査|せいみつけんさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧ (a detailed examination is needed)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{健康診断|けんこうしんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧ — health checkup; the routine annual screening that may lead to {精密検査|せいみつけんさ}
- ⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧ — examination, inspection; the general term
- ⟦{人間|にんげん}ドック→人間ドック：23310_ningendokku⟧ — comprehensive health screening; a voluntary, thorough checkup (from "human dock")

USAGE:
In Japan's healthcare system, annual ⟦{健康診断|けんこうしんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧ (health checkups) are standard for employees and residents. If something abnormal is found, the next step is a {精密検査|せいみつけんさ} — a follow-up with specialized testing such as MRI, CT scans, or endoscopy.
